source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 19 May 1949, p. 4 ("Rural councils: four new members in Castlereagh")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Names re-checked on the cited page BNL19490519.1.4 with a fresh fetch of the INA OCR: all surnames present (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Castlereagh rural district, one member each. There was no contest in 1949. The News-Letter names the four new members and records that no nomination was received for the Castlereagh division, so the retiring member retained it. Three of the four re-nominated retiring members (Ballymaconaghy, Ballyhackamore, Gilnahirk) are recorded from reports of the new council's meetings (Belfast News-Letter, 11 June 1949; Belfast Telegraph, 12 August 1949), each with the division of the 1946 return; Craigavad remains unnamed (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). New member, in place of Mr. S. Boyd. Returned unopposed.
